card.title: Hello, Friend, Today
card.tagline: Apprenez à saluer quelqu'un et parler du moment présent.

sentence.english: Hello my friend, today is a beautiful day.
sentence.french: Bonjour mon ami, aujourd'hui est une belle journée.

song.title: Hello Friend Today
song.description: Une chanson douce pour mémoriser naturellement les trois mots du trio.
lyrics: Good morning light, a brand-new day.
Hello, hello, come take my hand,
Today we'll walk the gentle way.
The sun is up, the sky is clear,
Today is bright, today is here.
This lovely day will never end.
Good morning light, a brand-new day.
Hello, hello, come take my hand,
Today we'll walk the gentle way.
